text:
emily.g: quick pulse check — i've been sketching a lightweight decision lattice for choosing fp8/int8/4bit for in-flight tokens. want to validate signals + rollout plan.

raj.k: sounds promising. what inputs are you considering?

emily.g: minimal set to start: degradation_score, token_pos (head/mid/tail), kv_cache_hit, model_op_support. output: allowed_bitwidths + explain_tag.

raja.k: can we avoid per-token oscillation? that killed us last time.

emily.g: yes — add hysteresis and a token-window lock: only allow bitwidth changes at sentence boundary or if stability window (N tokens) exceeds threshold. also cap one change per-request.

taylor: example rule?

emily.g: prototype grammar snippet: 

```
rule r1 {
  when degradation_score <= 0.03 and token_pos == tail and kv_cache_hit == true
  then allow = [fp8, int8]
  rationale = "low risk tail with cached kv"
}
rule r2 {
  when degradation_score <= 0.06 and model_op_support includes fp8
  then allow = [fp8]
}
rule default {
  allow = [fp32]
}
```

morgan: add a score for estimated_quality_risk so we can sort allowed_bitwidths by safety.

dave.ops: ops note — we need a hashed rule id and short counters, otherwise Prom cardinality will explode. use dl.rule=hash. sample full context 0.5% only.

hana-bot: telemetry spec: attach dl.rule, dl.inputs=(dl.ds,dl.pos,dl.kv), dl.allowed, dl.risk_bucket. include trace_id when sampled.

raj.k: how do we handle model variant incompatibilities? some kernels choke on fp8 in fused ops.

emily.g: runtime should query model_adapter.supported_bitwidths(model_id) and intersect. if intersection empty -> check higher-fidelity variant or route to slow-path (no quant). tag decision with fallback_kind.

taylor: rollout: shadow for 14 days, 5% traffic, compare per-cohort regression metrics (exact-match, rouge, hallucination rate). auto-block cohort if regression > X.

morgan: define X?

emily.g: propose: exact-match drop > 0.5% absolute or hallucination increase > 0.2% triggers auto-disable. can tune.

dave.ops: add circuit-breaker: if latency_p99 for fp8 path increases by >10% relative to baseline for 5m, pause changes and roll to safe path.

hana-bot: add unique telemetry_id per decision: dl.id = short(hash(rule_id + model + cohort)). keeps it small.

raj.k: sampling capture: we need seed inputs for repro — store prompt hash + model_version + kv_snapshot when sampled. privacy filter before storing.

emily.g: agree. store minimal repro: prompt_hash, deterministic_seed, kv_prefix_hash. ops will redact PII.

taylor: runtime API: GET /v1/bitwidth-decision?inputs=... return {rule_id, allowed_bitwidths, risk_score, explain}. make explain human-readable short tag.

morgan: maintain config precedence: customer_pin > endpoint_flag > lattice_default. document in ops playbook.

emily.g: next steps: i'll draft a short RFC with grammar, telemetry fields, runtime API, rollout matrix, and ops circuit-breakers. can folks review tomorrow AM?

dave.ops: will add ops checklist for sampling quotas and alerting thresholds.

raj.k: i'll write compatibility matrix for model adapters (which ops support which bitwidths).

emily.g: thanks — will ping when i put the RFC up. tagging @taylor @morgan for rollout/ops bits. :sparkles:
